name: The Ninth Day Literary Gathering at Xing’an [Temporary Retreat]
material: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
summary: By the 1700s, Yangzhou was flourishing both economically and culturally as the most prosperous city in China, having surpassed all other Jiangnan cities in their creation of gardens. This group portrait commemorates a literary gathering in the private garden of the salt merchants and art patrons Ma
